dashboard.label: Network Connections
dashboard.description: Process-to-network correlation via Sysmon EID 3 and firewall logs

search.query: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3 | stats count by host | fields host
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3 host=$host_filter$ | stats count by DestinationIp | sort -count | head 20
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3 host=$host_filter$ | stats count by DestinationPort | sort -count | head 20

index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3 host=$host_filter$ Initiated="true" | stats count values(DestinationIp) as dest_ips dc(DestinationIp) as unique_dests by host, Image | sort -count

index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3 host=$host_filter$ Initiated="true" | stats count avg(_time) as avg_time stdev(_time) as stdev_time range(_time) as time_range by host, Image, DestinationIp, DestinationPort | where count > 5 AND stdev_time > 0 | eval regularity = round(stdev_time / (time_range / count), 2) | where regularity < 0.5 | sort regularity | table host, Image, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, count, regularity
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3 host=$host_filter$ | table _time, host, User, Image, Protocol, SourceIp, SourcePort, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, Initiated | sort -_time
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=22 host=$host_filter$ | stats count by host, Image, QueryName | sort -count
